name: coordkit
description: Same-machine multi-instance coordination, packaged here as the Claude Code adapter: a per-repo bus + cross-instance ledger that tracks who else is live, which files they touch, and which subagents they're running, and surfaces it. NEVER BLOCKS BY DEFAULT — out of the box these hooks only observe and warn. Includes the opt-in hard anti-clobber guard (formerly the coordguard plugin, merged at 3.0.0): off unless you run /guard on. As of 4.0.0 also includes skill auto-activation (formerly the skillkit plugin): a UserPromptSubmit hook that matches prompts against layered skill-rules.json files and suggests skills, plus a shared roster of specialized agents and /dev-docs context-persistence commands available to every live instance.
